title: Associate Talent Acquisition
description:
**Job Title: Associate Talent Acquisition** 

Location: Delhi HQ – Full\-time on\-site

Reporting To: Head of Talent Acquisition

Employment Type: Full\-time

Start Date: As early as possible.

**About the Company \& Project**

Carbon Secure India Pvt. Ltd. (CSI) is a fast\-growing climate\-tech startup building a large\-scale biochar carbon removal project on a 60 acre site.

Using paddy straw and rice husk as feedstock, we operate artisanal kilns scaled to industrial levels in Ludhiana, Punjab.

Carbon is sequestered through innovative burial of biochar in underground vertical silos for durable, high\-integrity credits.

Commercial production commences in June 2026, with a targeted scale\-up to 50 MT of biochar per day by year\-end.

We are now enhancing our infrastructure with an innovative molten salt pyrolysis process that will scale considerably at exceptional pace.

**Role Overview**

As Associate Talent Acquisition, you will support the Head of Talent Acquisition in executing high\-volume, high\-quality recruitment across senior, technical, and operational roles.

This is a hands\-on role ideal for someone who enjoys end\-to\-end recruitment, thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment, and wants to grow with a high\-impact climate\-tech company.

You will gain exposure to hiring for climate\-tech leadership, engineering, procurement, supply chain, and operations roles while building strong recruitment skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

Support full\-cycle recruitment for multiple open positions simultaneously (leadership, technical, and site\-based roles in Ludhiana).

Post jobs on Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, and other relevant platforms; manage responses and applications.

Conduct initial resume screening, candidate shortlisting, and preliminary phone/video screening calls.

Coordinate interview schedules with candidates, hiring managers (including the Founder), and the Ludhiana team.

Maintain accurate and updated candidate pipelines and tracking sheets.

Assist in preparing offer letters, conducting reference checks, and supporting onboarding documentation.

Help with candidate experience — timely communication, feedback, and follow\-ups.

Support sourcing through direct outreach, employee referrals, campus networks, and niche job portals.

Track recruitment metrics (time\-to\-hire, source effectiveness, etc.) and prepare simple weekly reports.

Coordinate logistics for Ludhiana site interviews and candidate visits.

Contribute to building a strong employer brand for our climate\-tech mission.

**Requirements**

1–4 years of experience in recruitment / talent acquisition (experience in startups, manufacturing, engineering, or agribusiness is a plus).

Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (HR, Business, or related fields preferred).

Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi.

Strong organisational and coordination skills with high attention to detail.

Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Workspace, and comfort with job portals / LinkedIn Recruiter.

Proactive, energetic, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced, dynamic startup environment.

Genuine interest in climate action and sustainability is highly desirable.

Willingness to occasionally travel to Ludhiana for candidate coordination.

**Compensation**

Base Salary: ₹6 – 8 lakhs per annum (depending on experience)

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should send their resume and a short note (max 150 words) explaining why they are interested in joining a climate\-tech startup and building recruitment capability.

Please mention “Associate Talent Acquisition” in the subject line and include your expected salary and earliest joining date.

Applications should be sent to founder@carbonsecure.in .

description:
Designation: NA


Location: India West Bengal Bangur BFL Estate, Kolkata


Organization: Financial Services

**Job Description:**
--------------------

#### **Job Purpose**


Job Purpose Description

#### **Job Context \& Major Challenges**


Organization Context  

Aditya Birla Finance Limited ("ABFL"), a lending subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited is among the leading well\-diversified non\-banking financial services company in India. ABFL offers customized solutions in areas of personal finance, mortgage finance, SME finance, corporate finance, wealth management, debt capital markets and loan syndication. ABFL is registered with RBI as a systemically important non\-deposit accepting non\-banking finance company (“NBFC”) and is amongst the top five largest private diversified NBFCs in India based on AUM.  

For the FY ended 31st March 2020, ABFL has a lending book of Rs. 47,075 crores, net PAT of Rs 821 Crores and net worth of 8,078 crores. The Net Interest Margin expanded by 38 bps y\-o\-y to 5\.29% and operating profit is growing at 16% y\-o\-y. ABFL’s long\-term credit rating of AAA (Stable) has been reaffirmed by ICRA. ABFL also has long\-term credit rating of AAA (Stable) by India Ratings, Perpetual debt credit rating of AA\+ (Stable) by ICRA and AA\+ (Stable) by India Ratings (Stable) and short\-term credit rating of A1\+ by ICRA \& India Ratings.  

  

Job Context  

Collections function carries out monitoring of client wise exposure and portfolio exposure to identify ‘early warning signals’ of stress and to minimize NPAs. This monitoring is done by dedicated teams who specialize in managing delinquent customers who have come under financial stress due to unfavourable market events / changes in business patterns and as well as from those customers who have intentionally stopped payment of dues with mala\-fide intentions. It also carries out overdue loan recovery from defaulting clients.  

  

This role is responsible for enhancing business profitability through effective management of the delinquent portfolio in the respective area. The incumbent will be accountable for field collections for the customers in the area. For this segment, the collections model is a combination of in\-house (for ticket sizes \>10L) and partly agency\-driven (for small ticket sizes) so the area manager will need to effectively oversee both inhouse collections officers as well as agency managers.

#### **Key Result Areas**

  

**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** **Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**  


KRA1 Achieve collections targets and financial goals for the area- Monitor and Control delinquency and minimize credit losses for portfolio
  

- Drive higher resolution rates.
  

- Ensuring adequate headcount availability location\-wise / bucket\-wise / segment\-wise.
  

- Ensure Charge offs are minimized and higher recoveries from charge\-off accounts.
  

- Review, maintain control and minimize the cost incurred towards collections of dues.
  

- Daily monitoring and regular reviews of delinquent portfolio to make account level
  


KRA2 Portfolio review and monitoring- Monitor customer accounts across the region, identifying and flagging likely cases of default or delayed payment
  

- Work with non\-performing defaulting borrowers to create optimum recovery solutions
  

- Developing various MISs to show different cuts and trends in the portfolio which can lead to necessary corrective action by collections team to enhance their performance and shows area of improvement.
  

- Provide regular inputs to Management and all the other stakeholders such as Sales, Risk, Policy Team on various aspects of collections resolution and delinquency trends, Negative Areas, Negative Profile, Non\-Starters, SKIPs, Fraud Cases, etc.
  


KRA3 Vendor Management- Liaise with agencies to drive collections processes efficiently.
  

- Oversee selection processes for externa agencies
  

- Continuously monitor agency performance
  

- Exercise adequate control on agencies to ensure collection of overdue debts in a timely manner
  


KRA4 Compliance and audit- Ensure that all documentation related to the collections process is maintained in accordance with internal norms and regulatory requirements
  

- Respond to customer complaints regarding the collections process, taking steps to ensure a satisfactory outcome for both ABFL as well as its customers
  

- Plan and implement periodic audits of the collections teams, ensuring their compliance with all relevant policies and regulations
  


KRA5 Customer escalations and complaints- Coordinate with the legal team and senior management in the event of escalated cases to ensure compliance with relevant regulations
  


KRA6 People Management- Provide oversight and be a coach and mentor for the team
  

- Ensure regular functional \& behavioral trainings of team members in collaboration with HR
  

- Participate in relevant talent management and people development activities to ensure a healthy pipeline and an engaged team

title: Plant Manager
description:
**Job Description: Plant Head / Plant Manager (Engineering)**

**MEGA LINK CHAINS (INDIA) LTD**  
**B\-38, ADDITIONAL AMBARNATH MIDC, DIST\-THANE 421506, MAHARASHTRA**

**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Reports To:** Chief Operating Officer (COO) / Vice President of Operations

**About Us**

We are India’s leading manufacturers \& exporters of Steel link chains for High Tensile load lifting application, we have state of the art manufacturing facility with imported machines. We have manufacturing facilities in India \& China.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a seasoned, strategic, and operations\-focused **Plant Head** to lead our manufacturing unit. The ideal candidate will have total P\&L responsibility for the plant, overseeing production, engineering, quality, maintenance, and supply chain to meet company goals. You will drive operational excellence, improve productivity, and foster a culture of safety, efficiency, and continuous improvement (Lean/TPM).

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Strategic \& Operational Leadership**

· **P\&L Accountability:** Own the overall plant P\&L, driving profitability through strict control of conversion costs, budget management, and optimal utilization of resources (man, machine, material).

· **Operational Excellence:** Formulate and execute daily, monthly, and annual production plans, ensuring 100% adherence to customer dispatch schedules and quality standards.

· **Leadership Team Management:** Lead the Plant Leadership Team (comprising Production, Quality, Maintenance, HR, Store/Purchase) to act as a cohesive unit aligned with company vision.

**2\. Manufacturing \& Engineering Excellence**

· **Process Improvement:** Drive productivity enhancement initiatives through Total Quality Management (TQM), TPM, and 5S methodologies.

· **Capacity Expansion:** Lead new project execution, tool room optimization, machine installation, and commissioning within scheduled timelines and budgets.

· **Quality Assurance:** Maintain robust quality monitoring systems (ISO, TS 16949\) to ensure zero\-defect production and minimize rejection rates.

**3\. Safety, Compliance, and Maintenance**

description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Learneo is a platform of builder\-driven businesses, including Course Hero, CliffsNotes, LitCharts, Quillbot, Symbolab, and Scribbr, all united around a shared mission of supercharging productivity and learning for everyone. We attract and scale high growth businesses built and run by visionary entrepreneurs. Each team innovates independently but has a unique opportunity to collaborate, experiment, and grow together, and they are supported by centralized corporate operations functions, including HR, Finance and Legal.


**Role Overview**  

The Senior Internal Communications Manager is responsible for helping bring the internal communications strategy to life through thoughtful planning, execution, and partnership. This role plays a key part in ensuring that employees are informed, aligned, and motivated about our strategy—primarily within QuillBot (\~80%), with additional project\-based support for Learneo Corporate (\~20%).



This person works cross\-functionally with leaders across the organization, including the QuillBot CEO, Chief of Staff, VP of HR and Learneo corporate leaders, to deliver clear, consistent, and timely communications that support business priorities and drive strategic alignment.


**Responsibilities**


* **Execute and operationalize internal communications strategy** by turning high\-level goals into clear, actionable communications across channels
* **Plan and deliver internal communications** for QuillBot, including:
	+ Company\-wide announcements and business updates
	+ Messaging and materials for Town Hall meetings, AMAs, planning, and company moments
	+ Drafting and editing communications from executive and functional leaders including strategy roll\-outs and updates, presentations, emails.
* **Contribute to communication efforts that support core business rhythms**, including onboarding, planning, and progress reporting
* **Support cross\-company communications efforts** for Learneo, including:
	+ Helping review and improve messaging for corporate communications
	+ Contributing and driving execution of project\-based communications initiatives (acquisition, re\-orgs)
* **Coordinate communications logistics and planning**, including maintaining comms calendars, aligning on timing, organizing and updating comms material for the business, and managing internal channels (e.g., Slack, email, town halls)
* **Collaborate with the People and Recruiting teams** to support communications around HR programs, benefits, and internal employer brand messaging
* **Help execute communication plans for key change initiatives**, high\-impact projects, and organizational updates
* **Ensure internal messaging reflects inclusive language and reinforces company values**, partnering with HR and leaders as needed
* **Contribute to communications planning** by sharing input and partnering with stakeholders to ensure clarity, tone, and timing are effective


**Qualifications**


* 7–15 years of experience in internal or corporate communications, ideally in high\-growth or global remote organizations
* A minimum of a Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
* Comfort advising and partnering with executives, with the judgment to handle sensitive information and maintain confidentiality
* Ability to translate complex strategies into clear, compelling communications across multiple channels (Slack, email, intranet, town halls)
* Strong track record drafting and editing executive communications, including presentations, emails, and strategy rollouts
* Experience working effectively with leaders and functions across the organization to align on messaging and communications needs
* Excellent writing, editing, and storytelling skills with a focus on clarity, tone, and inclusivity
* Familiarity with communications platforms and tools (Slack, intranets, video platforms)
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage calendars, timelines, and competing priorities
* High attention to detail and ability to navigate ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment


**Scope and Expectations**  

This role is focused on execution with ownership—taking initiative, managing communications with care, and contributing meaningfully to how the company communicates internally. Strategic direction is developed in collaboration with senior leaders; this role plays a critical part in executing that strategy across teams and moments. Corporate support is project\-based and primarily focused on advising and contributing to specific communications initiatives as needed.

  

**What Success Looks Like**


* Employees clearly understand the company’s strategy, current direction, and what success looks like
* Internal communications foster motivation, alignment, and a stronger sense of purpose across teams
* Leaders feel supported and confident in how messages are communicated  

The organization operates more smoothly and efficiently, with reduced friction and clearer decision\-making
* Communications contribute to faster execution and higher\-impact results across the business
* Internal messaging helps teams stay focused, move in sync, and deliver on top priorities


**Benefits \& Perks**


* Competitive salary, stock options \& annual bonus
* Medical coverage
* Life and accidental insurance
* Vacation \& leaves of absence (menstrual, flexible, special, and more!)
* Developmental opportunities through education \& developmental reimbursements \& professional workshops
* Maternity \& parental leave
* Hybrid \& remote model with flexible working hours
* On\-site \& remote company events throughout the year
* Tech \& WFH stipends \& new hire allowances
* Employee referral program
* Premium access to QuillBot

Overview:

This role is responsible for the **day\-to\-day operational delivery and administration of employee benefits** across India, APAC, and UAE. The incumbent will ensure **accurate, timely, and compliant execution** of all benefits\-related processes while providing excellent employee support and managing external vendors.

  

The role is hands\-on and execution\-focused, requiring strong coordination skills, ownership of operational timelines, comfort working in a matrix structure, and the ability to proactively flag issues and prepare data to support decisions.


Responsibilities:

Benefits Administration \& Employee Support

* Act as the first point of contact for all employee queries related to health insurance and other benefits.
* Support employees through insurance claim processing, coordinating closely with TPAs and insurance providers.
* Manage, track, and close employee cases through AskHR (or equivalent case management system) within agreed SLAs.
* Ensure accurate benefits onboarding and offboarding, including:
* + Timely enrolment of new hires into benefits programs.
	+ Deactivation of benefits for exiting employees.
* Maintain and regularly update benefits databases and trackers to ensure data accuracy.
* Download and maintain new hire reports; send welcome emails related to benefits.
* Manage monthly meal card administration, including enrolment changes, reconciliation, and issue resolution.

  

Communication, Inductions \& Awareness

* Send timely, clear, and accurate benefits\-related communications to employees, including policy updates and changes.
* Conduct benefits induction sessions for new joiners.
* Organise and coordinate insurance refresher sessions post policy renewals.
* Support employee engagement initiatives by coordinating wellness sessions with external vendors.
* Plan and coordinate employee wellness sessions in collaboration with external vendors.


Vendor Coordination \& Internal Stakeholders

* Act as the operational interface with TPAs, insurance companies, brokers, and other benefits vendors.
* Coordinate with vendors to resolve day\-to\-day operational issues, escalations, and service delays.
* Participate in negotiations with insurance providers/broker to optimize cost and coverage.
* Engage with Finance, Payroll, HR Operations, and other internal teams to ensure smooth benefits processing.
* Track invoices, validate billing, and ensure timely submission for payments in line with internal processes.
* Escalate critical issues promptly with clear context and data.

  

Renewals \& Ongoing Operations

* Support execution of insurance policy renewals across India, APAC, and UAE by:
* + Compiling claims data and utilisation reports.
	+ Coordinating required information with brokers and insurers.
	+ Supporting renewal timelines and administrative requirements.
* Participate in renewal discussions primarily from an operational and data\-preparation perspective, rather than ownership of strategy or design.
* Recommend improvements to benefits programs based on market trends and internal insights.

  

Reporting, Data \& Documentation

* Pull and consolidate operational reports (new hires, claims, vendor SLAs, query volumes).
* Maintain standard operating documentation related to benefits processes and vendor contacts
* Ensure benefits processes are executed accurately, on time, and in accordance with policy.
* Identify recurring issues or risks and flag them proactively with supporting data.
* Review employee feedback and benchmarking reports to enhance benefits design.


Qualifications:
**Key Skills \& Capabilities**

* Strong hands\-on experience in **benefits operations and administration**.
* Excellent **coordination and follow‑through** skills.
* Comfortable working in a **matrix reporting environment** with multiple stakeholders.
* Clear, empathetic, and effective **employee communication** skills.
* Strong **vendor coordination and escalation management** ability.
* Detail\-oriented, structured, and process\-driven.
* Ability to pull together data, spot trends, and support operational decision\-making.
* Self\-starter with a **proactive, ownership\-driven mindset**.

 **Experience \& Qualifications**

* 2–4 years of experience in **Benefits Administration, HR Operations, or Total Rewards Operations**.
* Prior experience working with **insurance providers, brokers, and TPAs** is desirable.
* Exposure to benefits operations is strongly preferred.
* Experience using HR systems, case management tools, and Excel\-based trackers.
* Bachelor’s degree required; HR or operations\-related certifications are a plus.

 **What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Seamless, issue\-free benefits operations throughout the maternity cover period.
* Employee queries resolved efficiently with high satisfaction.
* Renewals and vendor processes executed on time with minimal escalations.
* Strong operational grip with proactive flagging of issues and dependencies.


What do we offer:

Please submit resume/CV in English.

title: Dispatch Executive
description:
**Job Title: Dispatch Executive (Pharmaceutical Industry)**

**Location:** Rudrapur, Uttarakhand  
**Department:** Logistics / Supply Chain  
**Reports To:** Dispatch Manager / Warehouse Manager

**Job Summary:**

The Dispatch Executive is responsible for managing the timely and accurate dispatch of pharmaceutical products while ensuring compliance with regulatory guidelines, company policies, and documentation standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Plan and execute daily dispatch activities as per sales orders and delivery schedules
* Ensure proper packing, labeling, and handling of pharmaceutical products as per **GDP (Good Distribution Practices)**
* Prepare and verify dispatch documents such as:
* Invoice
* Delivery Challan
* E\-way Bill
* Transport documents
* Coordinate with transporters and logistics partners for timely delivery
* Maintain dispatch records and update ERP/Tally systems
* Ensure FIFO/FEFO (First Expiry First Out) during dispatch
* Verify batch numbers, expiry dates, and product quantities before dispatch
* Handle return shipments and damaged goods documentation
* Ensure compliance with **pharma regulatory standards** and company SOPs
* Coordinate with QA, Warehouse, and Sales teams for smooth operations

**Required Qualifications:**

* Graduate in any discipline (B.Sc / B.Pharm preferred)
* Knowledge of pharmaceutical products and dispatch processes

**Experience:**

* 1–4 years of experience in dispatch/logistics (preferably in pharma industry)

**Skills Required:**

* Knowledge of **ERP / Tally**  systems
* Understanding of **GDP \& warehouse practices**
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Attention to detail and documentation accuracy
* Ability to work under deadlines

**Additional Requirements:**

* Knowledge of **temperature\-controlled logistics** (if applicable)
* Familiarity with regulatory compliance and audit requirements
* Basic computer skills (MS Excel, Word)

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* On\-time dispatch rate
* Documentation accuracy
* Order fulfillment efficiency
* Compliance with regulatory standards

title: Human Resource Executive
description:
**Job Title : HR Executive** 

**Job Type :** Full\-Time

**About Us :**

Welcome to **Agarwal Estates**! We are an **ISO 9001:2015** certified real estate company with a strong foundation built on trust and transparency. Based in Bangalore, we have been recognized as one of The **Happiest Places To Work in 2024**! At Agarwal Estates, we believe that every employee deserves the opportunity to grow, and we offer intensive training with **ICF\-certified coaches** to all team members.

**Why You’ll Love Working With Us:**

\- **Social Wealth:** Be part of an ethical organization known for trust and transparency. Work with a team that values and empowers you every day.

\- **Time Wealth:** Achieve work\-life balance with our 8\-hour workday and flexibility to work from home—yes, quality time with family is a priority!

\- **Physical Health:** We support your wellness with 50% coverage for programs at Jindal Naturopathy and Vipassana, and we even give you 10 extra days off for it. Plus, we plant a tree for each of our customers—because we care about the planet too!

\- **Financial Health:** Your hard work deserves reward, so we make sure to share the benefits of our success with our amazing team.

**Your Role:**

As an HR Executive, you’ll be the driving force behind our happy workplace. You’ll help us find the right talent, onboard them with care, and support their journey with us from day one.

**What You’ll Do:** 

\- **Recruitment \& Onboarding:** Help us grow by finding the best talent and making their transition into the company smooth and exciting.

\- **Employee Relations:** Keep the good vibes flowing by supporting employee well\-being, resolving conflicts, and boosting engagement.

\- **Performance Management:** Guide our teams in reaching their goals and unlocking their potential with development plans and feedback.

\- **Payroll \& Benefits:** Ensure our people are paid on time and that they understand the fantastic benefits we offer.

\- **Compliance \& Documentation:** Keep everything running smoothly by maintaining proper records and staying compliant with HR regulations.

\- **Training \& Development:** Work closely with our ICF\-certified coaches to ensure everyone’s growing and developing, no matter their role.

**What You’ll Need :** 

\- A bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or related fields.

\- 2\-4 years of HR experience (real estate industry is a bonus, but not required!).

\- Great communication skills, and a knack for bringing people together.

**How to Apply:**

Excited to join us? Send your resume and cover letter to hr@agarwalestates.com with "HR Executive Application – Agarwal Estates" as the subject.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement

Work Location: In person

title: People Services Specialist (HR)
description:
**About the Role:**  

**Grade Level (for internal use):** 09
  
S\&P Global Corporate
  
  

**The Role:** People Services Specialist (HR)
  
  

**The Team:** This role sits in our EMEA (HR) People Services team in a team of 9 individuals providing People Services support for the whole of EMEA. The current team are based out of the UK, Poland, Romania, South Africa, Germany, France and Spain. The role will report to EMEA Regional Lead, People Services, based in the UK. This role can be based out of Gdansk Poland. Other suitable locations would be considered.
  
  

**The Impact:** The People Services Specialist (HR) provides first line support to our employees giving knowledgeable advice and support as well as performing accurate administration for the employee lifecycle. The candidate will also provide support to the Regional People Advisors. We are making changes and improvements to the employee experience as we develop our People Processes and Systems.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Responding to UK, Ireland and Guernsey Country queries (‘tickets’) raised in Service Now (internal HR case management system) by employees within the agreed Service Level Agreements
  
  

Approving data requests in Workday (HR system) as required including absence, job changes, global mobility moves etc. and complete required documentation in collaboration with the employee and Regional People Partner .
  
  

Carrying out the end to end lifecycle processes for employees in conjunction with internal stakeholder and People Services team (onboarding, contracts and amendments; probation renewals, offboarding etc.)
  
  

Building knowledge and understanding of HR policies, practices and procedures including employee benefits and assist in maintaining Quick Reference Guides (QRG’s) in our internal library.
  
  

Liaising with our Benefits and Payroll teams to ensure data is accurately reflected for benefits and payroll administration.
  
  

Maintaining electronic employee files .
  
  

Supporting on ad\-hoc projects
  
  

**What We’re Looking For:**  

Strong HR Administrator with at least 2 years’ experience who may have worked previously within an HR/People Services environment ideally within a global organization.
  
  

Experience of supporting the UK is preferred. Additional EMEA locations experience would be an advantage.
  
  

Experience of People Services processes would be an advantage.
  
  

Experience of Workday and / or Service Now preferred but not essential.
  
  

Excellent organisation and administration skills
  
  

Fluent English (written and spoken).
  
  

Organised and solution orientated mindset, committed to resolving issues and attending to customer needs in a timely manner.
  
  

If office based, you'll be asked to work from office a minimum of 2 days per week, or 9 days per month. (subject to policy change).
  
  

Timing is flexible, Poland Morning hours. (Can start between 8am\-10am)
  
  

What’s In It For You?
  
  

**Our Mission:**  

Advancing Essential Intelligence.
  
  

**Our People:**  

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.
  
  

**Our Values:**  

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership
  
  

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.
  
  

**Benefits:**  

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S\&P Global.
  
  

**Our benefits include:**  

**Health \& Wellness:** Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.
  
  

**Flexible Downtime:** Generous time off helps keep you energized for your time on.
  
  

**Continuous Learning:** Access a wealth of resources to grow your career and learn valuable new skills.
  
  

**Invest in Your Future:** Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company\-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.
  
  

**Family Friendly Perks:** It’s not just about you. S\&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best\-in class benefits for families.
  
  

**Beyond the Basics:** From retail discounts to referral incentive awards—small perks can make a big difference.
  
**For more information on benefits by country visit:** https://spgbenefits.com/benefit\-summaries
  
  

**Global Hiring and Opportunity at S\&P Global:**  

At S\&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. Our hiring practices emphasize fairness, transparency, and merit, ensuring that we attract and retain top talent. By valuing different perspectives and promoting a culture of respect and collaboration, we drive innovation and power global markets.
  
  

**Recruitment Fraud Alert:**  

If you receive an email from a spglobalind.com domain or any other regionally based domains, it is a scam and should be reported to reportfraud@spglobal.com . S\&P Global never requires any candidate to pay money for job applications, interviews, offer letters, “pre\-employment training” or for equipment/delivery of equipment. Stay informed and protect yourself from recruitment fraud by reviewing our guidelines, fraudulent domains, and how to report suspicious activity here .
  
  

\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-
  
  

Equal Opportunity Employer
  
S\&P Global is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, military veteran status, unemployment status, or any other status protected by law. Only electronic job submissions will be considered for employment.
  
  

If you need an accommodation during the application process due to a disability, please send an email to: EEO.Compliance@spglobal.com and your request will be forwarded to the appropriate person.
  
  

**US Candidates Only:** Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal

**Brand:** 
 9FIGR

 Retail Excellence
 



 At
 **9FIGR** 
 , we believe that our people are the pulse of our brand. We are looking for a dynamic, people\-centric
 **Human Resource Manager** 
 who can bridge the gap between high\-performance retail operations and a nurturing company culture. You won't just be "handling HR"—you’ll be the architect of our team’s growth and the guardian of our workplace vibe.
 


 \#\#\#
 **Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Fresh Hiring** 

 Retail moves fast, and we need a team that can keep up. Your primary focus will be sourcing the next generation of retail stars.
 


* **Identify Potential:** 
 Scout and hire "fresh" talent—individuals who may be new to the industry but possess the energy, capability, and coachability to grow with 9FIGR.
* **Strategic Sourcing:** 
 Utilize social media, local partnerships, and innovative recruitment drives to keep a steady pipeline of capable candidates.
* **Onboarding:** 
 Create a seamless "Day 1" experience that turns new hires into brand ambassadors instantly.


**2\. Culture \& Internal Atmosphere Management** 

 The "vibe" of a store or office determines its success. You are responsible for keeping the 9FIGR spirit alive.
 


* **Vibe Check:** 
 Actively monitor the internal company atmosphere, ensuring it remains professional yet energetic and inclusive.
* **Conflict Resolution:** 
 Act as a fair mediator to resolve internal friction quickly and empathetically.
* **Team Building:** 
 Organize initiatives that break the monotony of retail and foster a sense of belonging among the staff.


**3\. Employee Happiness \& Engagement** 

 A happy employee provides a better customer experience. You’ll be the champion for our team's well\-being.
 


* **Morale Monitoring:** 
 Conduct regular check\-ins and feedback loops to ensure employees feel heard and valued.
* **Recognition Programs:** 
 Implement "Employee of the Month" or performance\-based rewards to celebrate wins, both big and small.
* **Work\-Life Balance:** 
 Manage rosters and shifts creatively to prevent burnout in a high\-pressure retail environment.

* **Accountability:** 
 Work with department heads to ensure all employees are clear on their tasks and executing them effectively.

 Identify skill gaps and provide the training necessary for employees to excel in their current roles and prepare for future ones.

 Move beyond "box\-ticking" exercises to provide genuine, constructive coaching.

 You have a "sixth sense" for talent and can spot potential in someone from a mile away.
* **The Stabilizer:** 
 You remain calm under pressure and can turn a tense workplace situation into a learning opportunity.
* **The Motivator:** 
 You genuinely care about people’s happiness and take pride in seeing your team succeed.
* **Retail Savvy:** 
 You understand that retail isn't 9\-to\-5; you’re adaptable and ready to support the team when the floor gets busy.

 At 9FIGR, we don't just sell; we lead. You will have the autonomy to shape the HR department and leave a lasting mark on the brand’s legacy. If you are passionate about people and ready to build a world\-class retail team, we want to meet you.

**Discover your future at Citi**

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of more than 230,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Role Overview**


The **Senior Vice President – Global Workforce Management Analytics** is a senior leadership role responsible for driving **enterprise‑wide workforce planning, optimization, and analytics** across Global Operations. The role partners closely with Operations, Business, and Workforce leaders to ensure the organization has the **right capacity, skills, and deployment** to meet customer demand efficiently and safely.


This role leads analytics that enable **demand forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling optimization, productivity management, and workforce risk mitigation**. The SVP will also drive the **adoption of AI‑enabled workforce solutions** and build **future‑ready WFM analytics capabilities** to support evolving operational models.


The position requires strong operational judgment, advanced analytical thinking, and the ability to influence senior leaders through data‑driven insights.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Global Workforce Management Strategy**

* Define and execute a **global Workforce Management (WFM) analytics strategy** aligned with Operations, customer demand, cost efficiency, and risk objectives.
* Serve as a senior advisor to Operations and Workforce leaders on capacity, staffing, and workforce optimization decisions.
* Identify systemic opportunities to improve workforce efficiency, flexibility, and resilience through analytics.

**Demand Forecasting \& Capacity Optimization**

* Lead analytics supporting:
	+ Short‑ and long‑term demand forecasting
	+ Capacity planning across geographies, functions, and skill pools
	+ Staffing models aligned to volume, complexity, and service‑level requirements
* Ensure forecasting models are robust, scalable, and continuously refined based on performance and business changes.
* Drive insights that balance service delivery, employee experience, cost, and risk.

**Scheduling, Productivity \& Utilization Analytics**

* Drive analytics to optimize:
	+ Workforce scheduling and shift designs
	+ Utilization, shrinkage, and productivity
	+ Intraday and real‑time workforce performance
* Partner with Operations leadership to translate productivity insights into executable actions.
* Support consistent global standards while enabling regional flexibility where required.

**AI Adoption \& Advanced Workforce Analytics**

* Drive the **responsible adoption of AI, machine learning, and optimization techniques** in workforce forecasting, scheduling, and capacity planning.
* Partner with stakeholders to move AI‑enabled WFM solutions from pilots to **scaled, embedded operational usage**.
* Ensure workforce analytics solutions are explainable, auditable, and aligned with risk and regulatory expectations.

**Business Partnership \& Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong relationships with senior Operations, Workforce, and Business stakeholders globally (US, APAC, Global).
* Independently manage complex stakeholder engagements, from problem definition through insight delivery and sustained adoption.
* Influence decision‑making across matrixed teams without direct authority.

**Execution \& Delivery Management**

* Own end‑to‑end delivery of WFM analytics across a multi‑layered global team.
* Ensure consistent quality, timeliness, and business impact across forecasting, planning, and optimization initiatives.
* Balance near‑term execution needs with long‑term capability and platform evolution.

**Talent, Capability \& Culture Building**

* Build and sustain a **forward‑compatible Global WFM Analytics organization** with deep expertise in:
	+ Workforce forecasting and capacity planning
	+ Optimization and scenario modeling
	+ AI / ML applications in workforce management
	+ Operations and domain knowledge
* Lead and manage teams of **20\+ analytics professionals**, including people managers.
* Attract, develop, and retain top analytics talent with strong succession and leadership depth.
* Foster a culture of analytical rigor, continuous learning, innovation, and ethical AI usage.

**Risk, Governance \& Workforce Controls**

* Ensure workforce analytics appropriately incorporate operational risk, labor considerations, and regulatory expectations.
* Partner with Risk, HR, and Operations to support safe, compliant, and sustainable workforce decisions.
* Escalate and manage workforce‑related risks with transparency and sound judgment.

**Required Experience \& Skills**

**Experience**

* **15\+ years** of overall experience, with **10\+ years in analytics**, preferably supporting Workforce Management or Operations.
* **6\+ years** leading analytics teams in large, matrixed, global organizations.
* Strong experience in **financial services, large‑scale operations, or customer service environments**.
* Demonstrated impact in workforce planning, capacity optimization, or productivity analytics at scale.
* Deep understanding of workforce drivers including demand, capacity, skills, and cost trade‑offs.

**Analytics \& Workforce Skills**

* Expertise in workforce analytics, forecasting, capacity planning, and optimization.
* Strong problem‑solving and analytical modeling capabilities.
* Experience designing scalable analytical frameworks rather than one‑off analyses.
* Familiarity with AI / ML concepts applied to forecasting, optimization, and workforce decision‑making.

**Leadership \& Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong strategic thinking with a clear bias for execution and outcomes.
* Executive presence with the ability to influence senior leaders through analytics.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and fast‑changing environments.
* High ownership, accountability, and commercial mindset.

title: HR Data & Compensation Specialist
description:
**About MoEngage:**



MoEngage is an insights\-led customer engagement platform trusted by 1,350\+ global consumer  

brands, including McAfee, Flipkart, Domino’s, Nestle, Deutsche Telekom, and OYO. MoEngage  

combines data from multiple sources to help brands gain a 360\-degree view of their customers.  

MoEngage Analytics arms marketers and product owners with insights into customer behavior.  

Brands can leverage MoEngage Personalize to orchestrate journeys and build 1:1 conversations  

across the website, mobile, email, social, and messaging channels. MoEngage Inform, the  

transactional messaging infrastructure, helps unify promotional and transactional communication to  

a single platform for better insights and lower costs. MoEngage’s AI Suite helps marketers develop  

winning copies and creatives, optimize campaigns and channels that boost engagement, and help  

with faster execution.  

For over a decade, consumer brands in 60\+ countries have been using MoEngage to power digital  

experiences for over a billion monthly customers. With offices in 15 countries, MoEngage is backed  

by Goldman Sachs Asset Management, B Capital, Steadview Capital, Multiples Private Equity, Eight  

Roads, F\-Prime Capital, Matrix Partners, Ventureast, and Helion Ventures.  

MoEngage was named a Contender in The Forrester WaveTM: Real\-Time Interaction Management,  

Q1 2024 report, and Strong Performer in The Forrester WaveTM 2023 report. MoEngage was also  

featured as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Omni\-Channel Marketing Platforms for  

B2C Enterprises 2023\.


**About the role:**



This role is essentially the **"Intel Engine"** for the HR department. It is a dual\-function position that bridges the gap between technical data science and strategic human resources, specifically within the **Compensation \& Benefits (C\&B)** and **People Analytics** domains.


**Key Responsibilities:**


**C\&B Analysis**


* Provide compensation and benefits detailed analysis across all compensation/benefits


programs.  

* Support the design, change management, and communication of compensation programs


and practices based on the guidance received from the C\&B head.  

* Develop proactive, data‐driven recommendations related to retention, recognition,


promotions, transfers, job matching, and job levelling.  

* Support the C\&B leader with compensation projects with a high degree of initiative.
* Partner cross‐functionally across HR and business teams to support compensation


initiatives.  

* Benefits and Wellbeing Management: Provide support on benefits, wellbeing, and insurance


programs across the region, including cross‐market alignment, vendor coordination, and  

cost‐experience trade‐off analysis. Support reviews of plan design and coverage to enable  

consistent and sustainable regional approaches.  

* Global Benefits SPOC: Serve as the central point of contact for global benefit programs.


This includes tracking utilization rates, managing renewals, and analyzing the ROI of  

benefit offerings (e.g., insurance, wellness programs).  

* Budget Reconciliation: Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure the spend


aligns with the overall budget.  

* Coordinate the operational setup of annual merit and quarterly variable compensation


cycles within the HRIS/Comp tool to streamline performance\-based pay distributions.
**People Data \& Analytics \& Dashboard**  

* Develop and maintain People dashboards and reporting to support leadership


decision\-making.  

* Conduct in\-depth analysis on people data including hiring, workforce planning, promotion,


attrition, compensation, engagement to identify trends, disparities, and opportunities for  

improvement  

* Identify trends and provide actionable insights to the People team and executive leadership
* Create recurring people reports \& presentations to support various HR sub\-functions for


business reviews  

* Partner with HRBP’s and OD functions and support their initiatives such as talent reviews,


succession planning, and leadership development with necessary data insights as defined by  

these functions from time to time.  

* Build and manage reporting dashboards using tools (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau, Power BI,)
* Automate reporting processes to improve efficiency and data accessibility
* Maintain a single source of truth for People metrics

**Data Governance \& Quality**  

* Data Management: Collect, clean, and manage global people data (as and when required)


from various sources (HRIS, employee surveys, hiring platforms) to support delivery of  

external and internal reporting  

* Establish standard definitions and documentation for People metrics
* Partner with People Operations \& C\&B to improve data quality and reporting processes

**Requirements**  

* Education: Graduation or MBA with a dual specialization in Finance and HR is


preferred. Knowledge of behavioral aspects of HR.  

* Experience: 3 \- 5 years of experience in HR analytics, HR operations, or similar


data\-focused roles.
* Prior experience in HR analytics and/or Compensation \& Benefits analysis is


essential. Genuinely "enjoys the numbers" and finds satisfaction in a perfectly  

reconciled spreadsheet.
* Technical Mastery: Fluent in Looker Studio, Tableau or Power BI
* Advanced Excel (Data modeling, Power Query, complex logical formulas).
* Have a near\-obsessive focus on accuracy; and spot a mismatched decimal point or an


inconsistent data tag before it reaches the stakeholder's desk.

At MoEngage, we respect and value differences. We believe that when people from diverse  

backgrounds and perspectives collaborate, we create the most value – for our clients, our  

employees, and society. We embrace diversity and uphold a strong set of values. We are committed  

to inclusivity and take pride in providing equal opportunities for success and growth.  

Employment at MoEngage is based solely on professional competence, skills, and experience. We  

stand firmly against all forms of discrimination and support equal rights and opportunities regardless  

of gender, ethnicity, abilities, age, identity, orientation or expression, marital status (including  

pregnancy), religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by law.  

It is our policy to comply with all applicable national, state, and local laws related to  

non\-discrimination and equal opportunity. MoEngage is truly a place where everyone can bring their  

passions, authentic selves, and talents to work, collaborating to drive progress and solve meaningful  

challenges.


**Why Join Us!**  

At MoEngage, we are passionate about our team and technology \- see below to know more about us.



Life@MoEngage  

Tech@MoEngage  

Scale @MoEngage  

We handle more than a billion messages every day. Rest assured, you will be surrounded by really  

smart and passionate people as we scale much more to build a world\-class technology team.

Are you a Talent professional passionate about searching the right candidate in today’s fast changing environment? Do you think beyond the reach of conventional job sites? Are you an innovative and an insightful thinker who can provide solutions to complex talent search needs?


**Work you’ll do**

As an Assistant Manager in the sourcing team, you will manage a team of sourcing specialists working in a high\-volume environment for your business within the firm. You may work in any of our businesses involving Consulting, Tax, Advisory, or Audit. You may also work for our Internal Services through our Enabling Areas function catering to our corporate functions, or our global member firm needs.


Elements of your job are as follows:


* Lead the team of Sourcing Specialists (Analyst/Senior Analyst).

* Monitor, guide, support, and encourage the team members to reach their self\-development and initiatives.

* Provide support on strategic, and complex requisitions and provide surge support as needed

* Capture and report on metrics that show results, trends and opportunities in key talent markets and supported business

 Amagi, epitomizing the essence of freedom, embarks on an extraordinary mission to establish the world's foremost media technology business rooted in a foundation of goodness. **5\. Process Excellence \& Transformation** 



* Drive automation, scalability, and continuous improvement in Total Rewards processes and Evaluate and implement tools and systems to enhance efficiency and maturity

* 8 \- 12 years of experience in HR, with atleast 6 years in Compensation \& Benefits / Total Rewards
* Strong expertise in compensation design, merit cycles, incentives (short \& long term), and pay structures
* Experience in global or multi\-geo environments preferred
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills; proficiency in Excel/GSuite and compensation tools
* Experience with compensation automation systems is a plus
* Ability to work with senior stakeholders and influence decision\-making
* High attention to detail, strong ownership, and ability to operate in a fast\-paced environment
* MBA or equivalent qualification from a reputed institution preferred



  





**Behavioral Competencies:** 



* High visibility role working closely with the Director – Total Rewards
* Direct impact on hiring, retention, and cost optimization
* Exposure to global compensation practices across India and international markets.
* Opportunity to shape and scale Total Rewards in a high\-growth environment
* Strong pathway for future leadership within the function

title: Process Trainer
description:
ABOUT WTF GYMS
 



  





 WTF Gyms — Witness The Fitness — is India's largest centrally\-controlled fitness operator. We run 50\+ own gyms and 60\+ Powered Gym partner locations across Delhi NCR, with 26,000\+ active members and ₹40\.8 crores ARR. Featured on Shark Tank India Season 3\. Headquartered in Sector 9, Noida.
 



  





 ABOUT WTF POWERED GYMS
 



  





 WTF Powered Gyms takes independent gyms and transforms them into WTF\-branded, technology\-powered operations. The gym owner keeps ownership. WTF provides brand, technology, marketing, and — critically — operational standards and staff training.
 



  





 The difference between a good gym and a great gym is almost never the equipment. It is the people operating it and the processes they follow. The Process Trainer is the person responsible for building and sustaining that difference across every WTF Powered Gym.
 



  





 THE ROLE
 



  





 The Process Trainer is responsible for training all staff at WTF Powered Gym locations — gym managers, front desk executives, trainers, and housekeeping staff — on WTF's standard operating procedures, systems, and non\-negotiable operational processes.
 



  





 This is not a classroom\-only training role. You will train on the floor, in the gym, in real situations. You will train new Powered Gyms before they go live, retrain underperforming locations, and conduct ongoing process audits to ensure standards are being maintained after you leave.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL DO
 



  




* Deliver WTF induction training to all staff at newly onboarded Powered Gym locations — covering WTF OS, standard operating procedures, member experience standards, and brand protocols
* Train front desk staff on: member check\-in/check\-out, WTF app onboarding, lead handling and follow\-up protocols, membership renewal processes, and daily opening and closing checklists
* Train gym managers on: daily reporting, staff attendance management, WTF compliance checklist execution, equipment maintenance protocols, escalation procedures, and CRM usage
* Train trainers on: session logging in the WTF system, member goal tracking, attendance marking, PT session booking and confirmation
* Create and maintain training materials — SOPs, quick reference guides, visual checklists, and training decks — for every role in the Powered Gym operation
* Conduct re\-training visits to locations where compliance audits have identified process gaps
* Work with the Operations Executive to identify which gyms need process intervention and prioritise accordingly
* Track training completion and competency across your assigned cluster
* Continuously update training materials as WTF processes evolve
* Ensure every staff member is trained and certified before new gym locations go live



 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 Required:
 


* 2 to 5 years of process training, operations training, or L\&D experience — ideally in a multi\-location or franchise environment
* Experience training floor staff — not just managerial training (counter staff, floor staff, physical service environments)
* Ability to create training content yourself — SOPs, checklists, visual aids, training decks — not just deliver someone else's material
* Excellent communication in Hindi — the primary language of most Powered Gym staff
* Patient and systematic — you train the same process multiple times to multiple people without losing quality or energy
* Comfortable with field travel across Delhi NCR for on\-site training



 Preferred:
 


* Training experience in fitness, hospitality, retail, or franchise operations
* Experience with LMS tools or digital training platforms
* Experience building SOPs from scratch for a growing operation
* Knowledge of gym operations and fitness industry standards



 COMPENSATION \& DETAILS
 



  





 Fixed Salary: ₹30,000 – ₹45,000/month
 



 Location: Delhi NCR — field\-based with office time for content development
 



 Reporting To: Powered Gyms Operations Head / Training Manager
 



 Joining: Immediate to 30 days

At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals. For us, it’s all about bringing together people who are curious, collaborative and have the drive to make things possible for our clients and communities.


**YOUR IMPACT**



Are you a quick\-thinking self\-starter with a passion for the financial markets, have the desire to work closely with high net worth individuals and the ability to think outside the box? Our client service professionals provide proactive financial counseling, full\-service implementation, including tax preparation and investments, to address complexities of executives, entrepreneurs and high net worth individuals. We are seeking professionals with an understanding of the markets who have the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment where attention to detail, strong communication skills, and client service are essential to maintaining and enhancing our business.


**OUR IMPACT**


**Wealth Management**



Across Wealth Management, Goldman Sachs helps empower clients and customers around the world to reach their financial goals. Our advisor\-led wealth management businesses provide financial planning, investment management, banking and comprehensive advice to a wide range of clients, including ultra\-high net worth and high net worth individuals, as well as family offices, foundations and endowments, and corporations and their employees. Our consumer business provides digital solutions for customers to better spend, borrow, invest, and save. Across Wealth Management, our growth is driven by a relentless focus on our people, our clients and customers, and leading\-edge technology, data and design.


**Goldman Sachs Ayco**



Goldman Sachs Ayco (Ayco) partners with Fortune 1000 companies to design and implement tailored financial planning programs for their workforce and leveraging the 50\-year heritage of Ayco and the comprehensive resources of Goldman Sachs to meet the evolving needs of their employees. Ayco believes companies best serve their stakeholders and the greater economy when their employees financial lives are clear, understood and in their control. Ayco advisors and technical specialists help clients achieve their personal financial goals through education and guided implementation across seven key financial disciplines, including employee benefit planning.

Serving as the primary operational driver of the Executive Wealth (EW) team by triaging incoming inquiries and tracking client priorities:



Asist Advisor teams, who work one\-on\-one with individual and/or corporate clients providing comprehensive personal financial planning, investment planning and tax services to corporate employees, executives and other high\-net\-worth individuals



Work closely with Wealth Advisor teams to support their AYCO clients



Leverage your operational background and experience to contribute to a growing business



Proactively anticipate, determine and recommend solutions to meet client needs and/or resolve issues surrounding investment related transactions



Manage cash balances and private banking services in accounts



Resolve time sensitive client service\-related issues, including complex situations



Plan and manage new account onboarding process, asset transfers and other account service requests



Managing the pipeline of new business opportunities in Salesforce



Prepare various reports for clients in the areas of cash flow planning, income tax projections, investment allocation, investment performance, estate flowcharts, etc.



Facilitate various aspects of client portfolio performance reporting and analysis



Assist with tax activities, including tax return quality control, estimated payments, e\-filing



Interface with internal groups to complete various investment and operational tasks.



Complete positive/negative consent client emails, handle exception tracking and comments.

CA fresher Jan'26 cleared



Proficiency in Microsoft products such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook



Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality



Enthusiastic and positive approach to problem\-solving and client service



Proven track record with cross\-training, task\-sharing and mutually supportive teamwork



Must be able to be innovative, pro\-actively manage time and follow through to complete tasks



Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills



Demonstrated ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment

title: Product Research Analyst
description:
**Job Description in brief:**


The Product Research Analyst will study existing product flows, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, conduct competitor and market research, and analyze available product and business data to generate actionable insights.


This role will help introduce a data\-driven approach into product decisions by combining product research, market and competitor analysis, and basic data interpretation. The person will support the product team in improving product quality, user experience, feature effectiveness, and overall product direction.


**Key responsibilities:**


* Study and document existing product flows, features, and user journeys
* Identify gaps, inconsistencies, and improvement opportunities
* Conduct competitor and market research to identify trends, opportunities, and relevant product patterns
* Analyze available product, operational, and business data to support findings
* Track and evaluate post\-implementation impact of features through before\-vs\-after analysis
* Prepare structured comparison reports, research summaries, and insight documents
* Support product discovery and improvement initiatives with actionable findings
* Work closely with Product Owners and Business Analysts to support decision\-making
* Proactively contribute to building a data\-driven product approach within the team


**Skill / Expertise / Work background:**


* Strong analytical and observation skills
* Ability to understand and break down product flows and user journeys
* Interest in product research, market research, competitor analysis, and benchmarking
* Basic understanding of data analysis, trends, comparisons, and simple metrics
* Good working knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets
* Ability to interpret data and derive meaningful insights
* Strong documentation and presentation skills
* Good communication and structured thinking
* Candidates with exposure to product analysis, business analysis, research, reporting, dashboards, or data\-related work are preferred
* Candidates from data/analytics backgrounds can be considered if they show interest in product understanding and research


**Experience level:** 0–2 years


Freshers can be considered based on analytical ability, structured thinking, and interest in product research and data\-driven analysis


**Qualification:** Any graduate


Preferred:


* Engineering / Computer Science / IT
* Data / Analytics
* Business / Management

title: Research and Development Engineer
description:
**Role Overview:** We are seeking a detail\-oriented and innovative Junior R\&D Engineer to join our New Product Development (NPD) team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between initial concepts and functional reality. You will be responsible for assisting in the design, prototyping, and validation of complex systems, ensuring that every component is cost\-effective, manufacturable, and built to last.

**Key Responsibilities \& Performance Indicators**

**1\. Systems Design \& Integration**

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure mechanical, electrical, and software interfaces align perfectly during the first build.
* Maintain and audit the Bill of Materials (BOM) to ensure 100% accuracy in part specification and sourcing.
* Success Metric: Achieve a high Integration Success Rate and minimize BOM\-related rework.

**2\. Research \& Prototyping**

* Develop "Look\-and\-Feel" and "Proof\-of\-Concept" models to validate design intent.
* Investigate emerging technologies and assess their viability for the current NPD pipeline.
* Success Metric: Optimize Prototype Lead Time and contribute to the company's Innovation Index.

**3\. Validation, Testing \& Compliance**

* Execute rigorous stress tests and reliability assessments on prototypes.
* Document failure points and assist in iterative design improvements.
* Success Metric: Meet or exceed target Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) during validation phases.

**4\. Cost \& Lifecycle Management**

* Apply Design for Manufacturing (DFM) principles to reduce part counts and simplify assembly processes.
* Monitor prototype expenses to ensure alignment with the commercial production budget.
* Success Metric: Maintain strict Target Cost Adherence and improve DFM scores compared to legacy products.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Systems Engineering (or a related field).
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Fusion 360\), experience with BOM management, and familiarity with rapid prototyping (3D printing, CNC, etc.).
* Soft Skills: Strong analytical thinking, a "fail fast, learn faster" mindset, and the ability to communicate technical data to non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Experience: 0–2 years in a research, development, or manufacturing environment**

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher

Pay: ₹250,000\.00 \- ₹350,000\.00 per year

description:
**About the Company**

We are a fast\-growing AI solutions company that automates responses to Requests for Information (RFIs) from customers, with a focus on sustainability, compliance, and product specifications. Our systems use advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) models to generate accurate, context\-rich responses. To maintain the highest quality, we are building a human\-in\-the\-loop data team to support and improve AI output.

**About the Internship \+ Full\-Time Opportunity**

This is a 1\-month internship program for fresh graduates who want to start a career in AI support, data quality, and document review.

* During this internship, you will learn how our AI workflow functions, including how information is extracted, organized, and reviewed for accuracy. You will also get an introduction to how AI models improve through feedback, how RAG\-based systems retrieve information, and how data quality affects the final answers.
* You will work with sample datasets and example documents to practice reviewing extracted content, correcting system mistakes, and checking AI\-generated answers.
* Your learning speed, communication, attention to detail, and ability to follow structured processes will be monitored throughout the internship.
* Candidates who **perform well** will receive a **full\-time offer** for the Data Associate role, where they will begin collaborating directly with QA and tech teams.

**Key Responsibilities** 

**1\. RFI Question Extraction \& Verification**

* Identify and extract questions from customer\-submitted RFI documents (PDFs, Word, Excel, etc.)
* Categorize and structure questions accurately under the guidance of domain experts
* Ensure completeness and clarity of extracted data

**2\. Digitized Document Format Review**

* Review digitized versions of documents for formatting errors, misinterpretations, and incomplete data capture
* Make corrections and annotate issues to improve data quality for the AI training process
* Assist in maintaining metadata such as document type, language, and structure

**3\. AI Answer Review**

* Evaluate answers generated by the AI model based on accuracy, relevance, and clarity
* Highlight incorrect, ambiguous, or missing responses and suggest better alternatives
* Tag responses as Verified / Needs Review / Incorrect based on defined quality standards

**4\. Reporting \& Collaboration**

* Document and report issues found during data extraction, verification, or AI output evaluation
* Communicate clearly with development and QA teams to relay edge cases or repeated issues
* Assist in creating feedback loops to help the AI system learn from human corrections

**Qualifications** **Required**

* Strong attention to detail and ability to spot mistakes.
* Basic analytical thinking and problem\-solving mindset.
* Good command of English language – both written and comprehension
* Comfortable working with documents in various formats and using basic tools (Google Docs, Sheets, PDFs,MS Office tools)

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with ChatGPT or other AI tools is a plus
* Interest in AI, document processing, or quality control
* Interest in understanding how AI improves through feedback.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Document interpretation and summarization
* Basic understanding of data accuracy and formatting
* Communication and teamwork
* Initiative and adaptability in fast\-paced environments

**What We Offer:**

* 1\-Month Internship with potential Full\-Time Offer based on performance
* Competitive fresher salary with performance\-based incentives
* Work with cutting\-edge AI systems
* Mentorship from experienced AI/QA professionals
* Friendly environment
* Chance to own responsibility and demonstrate accountability
* Flexible Work Arrangements: Onsite or remote options (as per company policy).
* International horizons – work with international teams and clients from all corners of the world
* Company parties, team events and the opportunity to work with great colleagues from all over the world

description:
**Company Description:** 




 InnovyQ Solutions, based in Bengaluru, is transforming IT Services through cutting\-edge AI and machine learning technologies. InnovyQ is committed to diversity, innovation, and personalised experiences, boasting a proven track record of success and client satisfaction in building exceptional IT teams.
 



  





**Role Description:** 




 This is a full\-time, on\-site role for an OT Network SME (Operational Technology Connectivity, Industrial Switching, and OT Firewall) at InnovyQ Solutions, located in Bengaluru/Pune). The OT Network SME will manage and optimize operational technology networks, analyze and troubleshoot connectivity issues, implement network security protocols, and design robust and secure networking solutions. The SME will work closely with teams to ensure seamless communication within industrial systems and address operational challenges in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining high standards of network performance and infrastructure integrity.
 



  






 The OT Network SME is responsible for operating and supporting OT network environments across factories and industrial sites. The role ensures stable, secure, and resilient OT connectivity supporting plant operations, including industrial switching, OT firewalls, monitoring, incident response, remote access, lifecycle management, and network changes with minimal production impact.
 





  The engineer works closely with plant OT teams, central IT, security teams, onsite support, and vendors to deliver OT network services safely and reliably.
 




  





**Job Location:** 

  Pune / Bengaluru
 




  






  
 
**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Operate and support OT LAN and connectivity services across manufacturing sites.
* Ensure network health, availability, and performance aligned with plant constraints and SLAs.
* Support centralized remote operations for OT environments.
* Manage industrial switching environments and plant connectivity.
* Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize switches, VLANs, segmentation, and redundancy.
* Support industrial protocols such as 
 
**PROFINET, Modbus, and EtherNet/IP** 

 .
* Support OT firewalls (e.g., 
 
**mGuard** 

  or equivalent).
* Implement firewall rules, segmentation, NAT, and secure communication paths.
* Align OT network changes with cybersecurity and plant security requirements.
* Coordinate with security teams on hardening, patching, vulnerabilities, and secure remote access.
* Monitor OT networks using approved tools.
* Troubleshoot and resolve incidents, especially production‑impacting issues.
* Participate in major incidents and maintain accurate ITSM updates.
* Execute planned OT network changes within approved processes and maintenance windows.
* Support upgrades, new site rollouts, and design changes.
* Maintain configurations, backups, baselines, and rollback plans.
* Support secure OT remote access for internal teams and approved vendors.
* Ensure access follows defined approvals, monitoring, and security controls.
* Manage OT IP addressing, subnet planning, and documentation.
* Support firmware upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management of OT devices.
* Track EOL/EOS risks and coordinate upgrades during plant shutdown windows.
* Coordinate with onsite teams, OEMs, and vendors for break‑fix, RMA, and escalations.
* Maintain OT network documentation, diagrams, inventories, and runbooks.
* Contribute to RCA and continuous improvement of OT network operations.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience:** 




  





**Technical Skills** 



* Strong experience in 
 
**OT / industrial network operations**
* Hands‑on experience with 
 
**industrial Ethernet switching**
* Experience with 
 
**OT firewalls (mGuard preferred)**
* Knowledge of network segmentation, IT/OT separation, and OT security zones
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, redundancy, NAT, ACLs, and firewalls
* Experience with monitoring tools, incident/change management, and lifecycle activities
* Knowledge of 
 
**Purdue model and OT cybersecurity** 

  is desirable



  





**Experience** 



* 5\+ years in network operations, with 
 
**2–3 years in OT / industrial environments**
* Experience supporting manufacturing plants or industrial sites
* Experience in high‑availability, safety‑critical environments



  





**Soft Skills** 



* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Calm under production‑impacting situations
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Strong documentation and change discipline
* Willingness to work in 24x7 or on‑call support models if required



  





**Preferred** 



* Experience in global manufacturing environments
* Exposure to OT cybersecurity, IT/OT convergence, or factory modernisation initiatives

**Position Summary**

Biorev Studios is hiring a **Quality Check Representative (QC)** who has a **strong eye for detail and interest in 3D architectural visualization**.

This is an **entry\-level opportunity for freshers or candidates with up to 6 months of experience** who want to start their career in **3D rendering quality control and visual review**.

The role focuses on **reviewing interior and exterior architectural renders, identifying visual inconsistencies, and providing structured feedback to artists** so that the final output meets professional standards expected by international clients.

This role is best suited for candidates who **enjoy analyzing visuals, spotting mistakes, and improving the quality of creative work.**

* Lighting
* Materials C textures
* Shadows
* Composition
* Modeling accuracy
* Scene realism

**2\) Compare Renders With References**

* Check renders against **reference images, design briefs, or architectural plans**.
* Identify mismatches in:
* Furniture placement
* Materials
* Colors
* Layout accuracy.

**3\) Provide Clear Feedback to Artists**

* Mark issues using **screenshots or notes**.
* Provide **clear and structured feedback** so artists can fix the issues quickly.
* Help reduce unnecessary revision cycles through precise instructions.

**4\) Maintain QC Documentation**

* Maintain **quality check records for projects**.
* Track corrections and revisions.
* Follow internal QC checklists to ensure consistent review standards.

**5\) Collaborate With Internal Teams**

* Work closely with **3D artists, QC leads, and project managers**.
* Participate in discussions about **quality improvements and visual standards**.
* Help ensure final deliverables meet **Biorev quality expectations**.

**Desired Attributes**

This role is perfect for someone who:

* Notices small visual mistakes others often miss
* Enjoys analyzing **images, renders, and architectural visuals**
* Is curious about **how realistic renders are created**
* Likes structured processes and quality standards
* Wants to build a career in **3D visualization or architectural rendering**

* Strong attention to **detail and visual accuracy**
* Good communication skills for giving feedback

* 3ds Max

* AutoCAD (basic understanding)

* Collaboration with artists and project teams
