description:
**Job Summary**

Ncore Builders is looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented Civil Draftsman to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing accurate technical drawings and plans for construction and interior projects. Both freshers and experienced candidates are encouraged to apply.

**LOCATION : PAYYANNUR**

**Working Drawing Preparation:**

* Prepare detailed working drawings for the entire project, including plans, elevations, sections, and construction details.
* Ensure all drawings are dimensionally accurate, reflect the design intent, and meet project specifications.
* Review design documents for compliance with building codes, standards, and regulations.

**Detailed Section Drawings:**

* Produce detailed section drawings that represent vertical cut\-throughs of the building to illustrate internal construction, material layers, and structural details.
* Focus on areas requiring in\-depth analysis, such as foundations, walls, floors, and roof connections.

**Detailed Elevation Drawings:**

* Prepare clear, scaled elevation drawings of all building facades, showing exterior details such as windows, doors, and architectural features.
* Specify materials, finishes, and surface treatments for the building’s exterior elements.

**Electrical Detailing:**

* Create detailed electrical drawings, including the layout of circuits, outlets, lighting fixtures, panel locations, and wiring connections.
* Work closely with electrical engineers to ensure the electrical system is properly integrated into the building design.

**Plumbing Detailing:**

* Develop plumbing drawings that include the layout of pipes, drains, water supply, fixtures, and valves.
* Provide details on plumbing connections, materials, and specifications to ensure the system meets code requirements and is operational.

**Tiles Laying Detailing:**

* Create detailed drawings for tile layouts in bathrooms, kitchens, floors, and other areas.
* Specify tile types, grout lines, installation patterns, and material finishes.
* Coordinate with contractors to ensure proper tile installation procedures are followed.

**Landscape Detailing:**

* Prepare detailed landscaping drawings that include plant layouts, irrigation systems, pathways, and outdoor structures.
* Detail features like lighting, fencing, and surface materials, ensuring they align with the overall architectural design.

**Compound Wall Detailing:**

* Provide drawings detailing the design and construction of compound walls, including foundation, material selection, and structural components.
* Ensure wall details are in compliance with safety standards and functional requirements.

**Structural Detailing:**

* Develop structural drawings that detail the design and construction of elements such as foundations, beams, columns, slabs, and other load\-bearing components.
* Coordinate with structural engineers to ensure structural integrity and compliance with building codes.

**Joinery Detailing:**

* Prepare detailed joinery drawings for custom woodwork, cabinetry, doors, windows, and other wooden elements.
* Specify material types, finishes, dimensions, and hardware for precise fabrication and installation.

**Set Out Detailing:**

* Develop set\-out drawings that show the exact placement of key structural elements, foundations, walls, columns, and other critical components on the construction site.
* Ensure accurate alignment and positioning according to the architectural design.

**Set Out Plan Preparation:**

* Create set\-out plans that provide clear instructions on the layout of the building on the site, ensuring that all measurements are precise and aligned with the design documents.
* Coordinate with site surveyors and construction teams for accurate implementation.

**Truss Work Detailing:**

* Provide detailed drawings for roof trusses, including dimensions, material specifications, and connection details.
* Collaborate with structural engineers to ensure the trusses meet safety and load requirements.

**Requirements :**

* Proficiency in AutoCAD and other drafting software
* Basic knowledge of construction methods and materials
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Good communication and teamwork skills
* Diploma or degree in civil engineering, drafting, or related field.

**Experience**

* 1\-2 years of experience in civil drafting (preferred)
* Experience in infrastructure, roadworks, drainage, or land development projects is an advantage Working Conditions

description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.

We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As a Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will play a key role in driving end\-to\-end campus hiring for Global Business Functions (GBF) in India. You will partner closely with Hiring Managers, HRBPs, and cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver a seamless, high\-quality hiring experience, ensuring strong pipeline creation, effective candidate assessment, and timely hiring outcomes. In this role, you will act as a trusted partner to the business, balancing hiring demand with market insights, while also focusing on enhancing candidate experience, strengthening campus engagement, and ensuring consistent execution of hiring processes at scale.

 **Key responsibilities include:**

* **End\-to\-End Recruitment**
	+ Manage full lifecycle recruitment for GAP roles across GS \& GSB
	+ Drive sourcing, screening, assessments, interviews, and offer processes
	+ Ensure timely closure of roles in line with hiring plans and SLAs
* **Campus Outreach \& Engagement**
	+ Drive campus outreach strategy across target universities and institutes
	+ Build and manage long\-term relationships with campus stakeholders (placement cells, faculty, student bodies)
	+ Lead and coordinate Pre\-Placement Talks (PPTs), info sessions, and engagement events
	+ Partner with Employer Branding teams to position BCG effectively on campuses
	+ Track campus performance and continuously refine outreach strategy
* **Stakeholder Management**
	+ Partner with Hiring Managers to understand role requirements and hiring needs
	+ Provide regular updates on pipeline, progress, and hiring insights
	+ Guide stakeholders through interview and selection processes
* **Candidate Experience**
	+ Ensure a smooth and engaging candidate journey across all stages
	+ Manage communication with candidates throughout the hiring lifecycle
	+ Support post\-offer engagement and onboarding readiness in collaboration with HR
* **Program \& Process Management**
	+ Execute structured hiring processes (HireVue, ATS workflows, interviews)
	+ Monitor pipeline health and proactively address bottlenecks
	+ Drive continuous improvements in hiring processes and candidate engagement
* **Data \& Reporting**
	+ Track recruitment metrics (pipeline, conversion, timelines)
	+ Maintain accurate data in ATS and trackers
	+ Provide insights to improve hiring effectiveness and campus strategy
* **Diverse Hiring Exposure**
	+ In addition to campus hiring, you will have the opportunity to expand your scope into lateral hiring during off\-campus cycles, supporting broader talent needs across GBF functions
	+ Partner with stakeholders to identify and attract experienced talent, contributing to year\-round hiring continuity

  

What You'll Bring

* Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred)
* 2–4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Campus Hiring, or Early Talent
* Experience in campus outreach and university engagement preferred
* Experience managing high\-volume or program\-based hiring

* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver in a fast\-paced environment

* Talent Acquisition team members

* External university stakeholders

title: Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition
description:
Bangalore, India
   

  

 At AXA XL, we are transforming the way we attract and grow top technology talent. As part of our bold vision to expand our Global Technology Center in Bangalore, we are scaling up our recruitment efforts and looking for passionate, forward\-thinking tech recruiters to join us on this exciting journey. We believe that getting top tech talent starts with exceptional recruiters. You will be part of our dedicated “tech recruitment squad”, and partner with HR Business Partners, Operations and Technology business leaders to attract the digital talent that will shape our future. While not a formal management position, your voice will matter as this opportunity is ideal for a seasoned recruiter who brings deep expertise and passion for mentoring. You’ll play a critical role in supporting the team members, helping elevate our recruitment capabilities as we scale and recruit niche top talents.
   

  

**What You’ll Be DOING**
 What will your essential responsibilities include?
   

  

* Understand the AXA XL business and talent strategy, consult with business and HR professionals on talent gaps and create and execute an effective and efficient sourcing strategy that delivers the best, most diverse global talent to AXA XL.
* Lead the execution of best\-in\-class recruitment. The Senior Recruiter will be tasked with leading search assignments that may be placed in various levels and functions across Operations and Technology.
* Network with industry professionals across the India market, with a specific emphasis on developing relationships with top tier, diverse talent.
* Partner with Talent Management and business\-based HR professionals to understand and address critical succession gaps and partner with our Talent Sourcing and Intelligence team to address those gaps. This includes managing external vendors, partnering with internal resources and ultimately presenting recommendations and action plans to senior leadership.
* Engage and partner closely with local HR and TA teams to ensure that all recruitment and onboarding practices for new hires are met.
* Execute the end\-to\-end recruiting process and sourcing strategies that result in better hires, faster, from needs identification to new hire’s first day. This includes creating and executing the research and effective and efficient sourcing strategy, candidate development, referrals, local stakeholder management, offer creation and negotiation.
* Maintain a global diversity sourcing strategy for AXA XL, including building effective external partnerships and relationships with diverse associations.
* Screen, evaluate and qualify candidates, including conducting in\-depth candidate interviews to develop a deep understanding of candidate qualifications and competencies.
* Provide written candidate profiles and search status reports and provide counsel regarding the interview process as well as the assessment and evaluation of candidates.
* Partner with Regional HR leadership and HR partners, as appropriate, to ensure that AXA XL can attract the necessary talent for today and tomorrow. This includes Total Rewards, Mobility. Employment Law and Talent Management.
* Select and manage global external search firm vendors, as needed. This includes identifying the “best” vendor, fee agreements and managing the firm throughout the entire recruiting process.
* Partner with HR leaders to assist with transition and onboarding for new executives.
* Provide substantive and competency\-based feedback to all unsuccessful candidates.
* Ensure an exceptional hiring manager and candidate experience.
* Positively represent and differentiate the AXA XL employment brand in the talent marketplace.
* Develop and maintain relevant market intelligence and regularly sharing that intelligence with global business leaders to inform optimal business and talent decisions.
* Maintain understanding of innovative recruitment tools, technologies, and best practices.
* Mentor and assist in the development of other recruiters.
* Attend appropriate business and HR staff meetings, as well as participate in recruiting, HR, and Enterprise initiatives.


 You will report to Head of Talent Acquisition \- ESS (India and Poland).
   

  

**What You Will BRING**
 We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
   

  

**Required Skills And Abilities**
* Bachelor’s degree required.
* Experience leading proactive recruitment for global companies and putting together comprehensive recruiting strategies to address diverse talent needs.
* A global talent perspective and experience working in a highly matrixed environment.
* Proven expertise in leading recruitment and managing a diverse set of global stakeholders, across multiple geographies (BU’s).
* Proven experience in information technology recruiting.
* Demonstrated ability to recruit diverse individuals and ability to negotiate and consult on total compensation packages (base, bonus, equity).
* Understanding of legal issues that impact recruiting activities, namely restrictive covenants, non\-solicitations and employment agreements.
* Ability to translate a business strategy into an actionable recruiting strategy.
* Exceptional communication (both written and verbal), influencing and negotiation skills.
* Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills with thorough attention to detail.


**Desired Skills And Abilities**
* Exceptional assessment and interviewing skills and an excellent command of assessment and selection methodologies, instruments, and processes.
* Excellent business acumen with a thirst for business knowledge.
* Effective project management skills with the ability to multi\-task and make decisions in a business context.
* Ability to develop a “big picture” perspective and be a strategic thinker.


**Who WE are**
 AXA XL, the P\&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid\-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
   

  

 How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data\-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
   

  

 With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
   

  

 Learn more at axaxl.com
   

  

**What we OFFER**
**Inclusion**
 AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
 *It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*
* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ\+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family\-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter


 Learn more at axaxl.com/about\-us/inclusion\-and\-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
   

  

**Total Rewards**
 AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
   

  

 We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
   

  

**Sustainability**
 At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever\-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023\-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
   

  

**Our Pillars**
* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems \- the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far\-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal\-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.


 For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.

description:
Position Title: People \& Performance Manager – Engineering Operations
 



 Department: Engineering / Projects
 



 Reports To: Director / Operations Head
 



 Location: Pune
 



 Experience Required: 6–12 years (Minimum 3\+ years managing engineering teams)
 



  





 1️⃣ Role Purpose
 


* The People \& Performance Manager will be responsible for driving discipline, accountability, productivity, and deadline adherence across Mechanical and Electrical engineering teams.
* This role ensures engineers meet project timelines, maintain documentation quality, follow structured work processes, and adhere to company policies related to attendance, communication, and performance standards.
* The position is execution\-focused — not administrative HR.



  





 2️⃣ Key Responsibilities (JR / KRAs)
 



 A. Performance Monitoring \& Output Control
 


* Implement daily/weekly task tracking systems.
* Monitor deliverables against deadlines.
* Track planned vs actual completion.
* Ensure engineers log daily work progress.
* Maintain a central performance dashboard.
* Identify low productivity trends early and intervene.
* KPI Examples:
* % tasks completed on time
* Average project delay variance
* Individual productivity score
* Rework/error frequency



 B. Deadline \& Project Discipline
 


* Conduct daily 10–15 min stand\-up reviews.
* Conduct weekly deadline review meetings.
* Escalate project risks proactively.
* Ensure no task remains untracked or ownerless.
* Coordinate with Project Leads for workload balancing.



 C. Attendance \& Workplace Discipline
 


* Monitor punctuality and attendance records.
* Enforce late\-coming and leave policies.
* Reduce unproductive desk time.
* Implement structured break systems if required.
* Address excessive phone usage or non\-work activities.



 D. Performance Management
 


* Conduct quarterly performance evaluations.
* Identify bottom performers and initiate improvement plans.
* Develop measurable improvement plans (PIP) with timelines.
* Recommend increments/bonuses based on measurable performance.
* Support high performers with growth pathways.



 E. Process Implementation \& Improvement
 


* Standardize reporting formats.
* Create task tracking systems (Excel/ERP/Project tools).
* Implement measurable KPIs for all engineers.
* Ensure documentation quality control.
* Drive continuous improvement culture.



 F. Conflict Resolution \& Team Stability
 


* Address internal conflicts affecting productivity.
* Maintain professional work environment.
* Prevent gossip\-driven performance decline.
* Act as escalation point for team disputes.



 G. Reporting to Leadership
 


* Weekly productivity report
* Monthly performance analysis
* Attrition risk identification
* Resource utilization report
* Recommendations for workforce optimization



  





 3️⃣ Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Industrial Engineering OR MBA (Operations/HR) with engineering exposure.
* Strong knowledge of engineering workflow.
* Experience in project tracking and performance monitoring.
* Strong command over Excel / project management tools.
* Ability to handle underperforming employees firmly but professionally.



  





 4️⃣ Required Skills
 


* Strong execution orientation
* Data\-driven decision making
* Assertive communication
* Process design capability
* Conflict handling
* Deadline enforcement discipline
* Performance analytics



  





 5️⃣ Key Success Indicators (First 6 Months)
 


* 30–40% reduction in missed deadlines
* Improved punctuality compliance
* Clear performance grading system implemented
* Daily tracking system functional
* Increased accountability culture



  





 6️⃣ Authority Level
 



 The People Manager will have authority to:
 


* Issue performance warnings
* Recommend salary increments or deductions
* Initiate PIP (Performance Improvement Plan)
* Recommend termination for chronic non\-performance (with leadership approval)

title: Training Manager for ERP
description:
The Training Manager plays a critical role in ensuring that Olympus employees, project members, and end users are fully equipped to adopt new SAP S/4HANA processes, systems, and associated business procedures within a regulated medical device environment. This position exists to design, manage, and execute a comprehensive training strategy aligned with Olympus’ Quality Management System (QMS), including controlled SOP‑based training, documentation, and learning lifecycle management. The role requires strong expertise in training design, system process understanding, LMS governance, and global coordination across diverse user groups. This position ensures training is structured, compliant, scalable, and tailored to the needs of multiple regions during a multi‑wave ERP transformation.
 



  





 PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 


* Develop and execute the global SAP S/4HANA training strategy, integrating business process training with regulated SOP/procedural learning requirements (10%).
* Lead the design and delivery of end‑user training for multiple deployment waves, beginning with Japan and Vietnam, including role‑based curricula, job aids, and eLearning (10%).
* Coordinate trainings and track completion for both project members and key users/ end users (20%)
* Manage upskilling programs for project members and subject matter experts (SMEs), ensuring readiness for solution design, testing cycles, data activities, and change impact assessments (5%).
* Ensure all training content, materials, and delivery approaches comply with Olympus QMS, including documentation standards, version control, and training effectiveness requirements (5%).
* Oversee end‑user procedure (SOP) training in alignment with regulatory standards applicable to the medical device industry (e.g., ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820\), partnering with Quality teams to ensure that controlled documents are integrated into training plans (10%).
* Manage and maintain the Learning Management System (LMS), including course creation, training assignment, completion tracking, and reporting to support global audit and compliance needs (10%).
* Collaborate closely with Process Owners, OCM, PMO, and IT to ensure training is aligned to business processes, change impacts, and cutover activities (10%).
* Support project leadership by preparing training governance materials, schedules, calendars, dashboards, and readiness reports (5%).
* Facilitate knowledge transfer from system integrators to internal Olympus teams and drive long‑term training sustainability models (5%).
* Oversee external training vendors and ensure content quality and delivery effectiveness (5%).



  





 Technical Competencies:
 


* SAP S/4HANA business process knowledge
* Learning Management System (LMS) administration
* Instructional design and adult learning methodologies
* Familiarity with validation, QMS documentation, and regulated training requirements
* Understanding of SOP lifecycle and controlled document systems (e.g., eQMS)



  





**Education\*:** 



* Bachelor’s degree required in Business, Education, Instructional Design, Information Systems, or related field.
* Master’s degree or certification in instructional design, learning management, or change management preferred.



**Experience\*:** 



* Minimum 5 years of experience in training management, instructional design, or learning \& development.
* Experience in large ERP programs (SAP preferred).
* Experience working in regulated industries (medical device, pharmaceutical, biotech) required.
* Experience managing LMS platforms and compliance‑driven training cycles.



**Skills:** 



* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA business processes
* Expertise in LMS administration and SCORM\-based content
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities
* Ability to manage training efforts across global deployments

description:
**Human Resources Manager — Seksaria Group** 
 📍 Mumbai, Maharashtra
   

  

**About Us** 
 The Seksaria Group is a diversified Indian enterprise with interests spanning sugar manufacturing, distillery and cogeneration, finance, and real estate. With operating units in Uttar Pradesh and a corporate presence in Mumbai, we combine the heritage of a long\-established business house with the ambition of a modern, professionally run organization. Our Mumbai office serves as the strategic and corporate nerve centre of the Group.
   

  

**The Role** 
 We are looking for a Human Resources Manager to lead the HR function for the Group from our Mumbai office. This is a generalist role with end\-to\-end ownership — from talent acquisition and employee lifecycle management to policy, compliance, and culture\-building. The role reports to Group leadership and will partner closely with business heads across divisions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is equally comfortable drafting an offer letter, negotiating with a search firm, running a payroll review, and sitting with leadership on organizational design. This is a hands\-on role in a lean corporate team — it rewards ownership, judgment, and the ability to operate without layers of support.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Talent Acquisition
   

  

* Own the full recruitment lifecycle for corporate and leadership roles — sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer negotiation, and onboarding
* Build and maintain a pipeline of talent across functions: finance, operations, commercial, technology, and administration
* Manage relationships with executive search firms, recruitment consultants, and job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, IIMJobs)
* Draft and publish job descriptions, job advertisements, and employer branding content
* Coordinate with unit HR at operating locations for plant\-level and field hiring as needed


 Employee Lifecycle \& Operations
   

  

* Administer the full employee lifecycle — onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, exits, and full \& final settlements
* Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files, and HRIS data
* Manage attendance, leave, and time\-office systems for the corporate office
* Oversee payroll inputs in coordination with Finance — ensuring accuracy of salary, reimbursements, variable pay, and statutory deductions
* Handle employee queries on compensation, benefits, and HR policy


**Compensation, Benefits \& Policy**
* Benchmark compensation against market and recommend salary structures and revisions
* Administer employee benefits — group medical insurance, group personal accident, gratuity, and other schemes
* Draft, update, and roll out HR policies — leave, travel, reimbursement, POSH, code of conduct, and employee handbook
* Manage the annual appraisal and increment cycle — calibration, letters, and communication


 Statutory Compliance
   

  

* Ensure full compliance with applicable labour laws — PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Gratuity, Bonus, Shops \& Establishments, Maternity Benefit, POSH
* Liaise with statutory authorities, consultants, and auditors for filings, inspections, and returns
* Maintain registers and records as required under Maharashtra S\&E Act and central labour laws
* Constitute and support the Internal Committee under POSH; drive annual training and awareness


 Employee Engagement \& Culture
   

  

* Design and execute engagement initiatives — town halls, offsites, festivals, birthdays, and recognition programs
* Act as a trusted point of contact for employee concerns, grievances, and conflict resolution
* Build a culture of professionalism, accountability, and respect across a multi\-generational, multi\-division workforce
* Partner with leadership on internal communications


 Learning \& Development
   

  

* Identify training needs across functions and coordinate programs — technical, behavioural, and compliance
* Manage external training vendors, executive coaching, and certifications
* Support leadership development for high\-potential talent


 HR Strategy \& Group Initiatives
   

  

* Partner with Group leadership on organizational design, role clarity, and succession planning
* Support M\&A, new ventures, and special projects with HR due diligence and integration planning
* Work with unit HR teams at operating locations to align policy and practice across the Group
* Build the HR foundation — systems, processes, and reporting — for a Group scaling into its next phase


**Experience**
**Who You Are**
* Progressive HR generalist experience, with at least 2–3 years in a managerial capacity
* Prior exposure to a multi\-entity group, family\-owned business, or diversified corporate setup preferred
* Experience operating as a sole or senior HR contributor in a lean corporate team is a strong plus
* Comfortable working across both corporate office and operating unit contexts


 Skills \& Competencies
   

  

* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance
* Solid command of HR operations — payroll inputs, benefits administration, HRIS, and MIS
* Sharp recruitment instincts, especially for mid\-to\-senior hiring
* Excellent drafting skills — offer letters, policies, internal communications
* Mature judgment and the ability to handle sensitive matters with discretion
* High degree of ownership and comfort operating without heavy process scaffolding


**Qualifications**
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, or an equivalent postgraduate qualification
* Proficiency in MS Office; comfort with HRIS platforms (Keka, GreytHR, Zoho People, or similar)
* Fluency in English and Hindi; Marathi a plus


**What We Offer**
* A central, high\-visibility role at the corporate heart of a diversified Group
* Direct access to leadership and a broad canvas to shape the HR function
* Competitive compensation and benefits
* A professional, respectful, and ambitious work environment in Mumbai

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Talent Consultant\- Manager**
 If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding career experience as a Talent Consultant in a high\-growth organization, we have a role here. At EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming and belonging. We care for our business, society and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 You will be responsible for supporting the Talent agenda for a business unit in EY GDS and will be the key point of contact for leadership on a range of talent related matters. You will drive and implement the engagement agenda, work closely with other members of the team to providing change leadership, increase workforce capability and talent management. You will build a deep understanding of business unit direction and Talent related topics/issues to ensure successful implementation of key projects and processes.
   

  

 You will need to be collaborative, influential and work across functions to execute on attracting, assimilating, developing, engaging and retaining key talent. You will drive project management for various HR initiatives, including Workforce Planning, Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward \& Recognition etc.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Support the Strategic Talent Consultant in designing a sustainable and scalable engagement framework for the business unit and take ownership for the delivery
* Provide support to the business leaders and counsellors in the implementation of engagement initiatives across the business unit
* Responsible for building, developing and managing other members of the talent consulting team, ensuring continued focus on the talent agenda
* Anticipate issues and needs within the business unit and address these effectively
* Act as a coach to business leader/managers in relation to delivering the people strategy agenda
* Provide insight on people issues, particularly ER cases within business unit, provide a robust point of view on business decisions and their impact upon people
* Ensure that all necessary people management and development activity required to support the business unit is delivered in the most professional and effective manner
* Execute innovative HR programs
* Facilitate change and support the implementation and successful adoption of special projects and initiatives in the business unit, for example: Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward exercises
* Ensure compliance to local regulations and manage risks (e.g. performance management risk)


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, ability to develop clear, actionable plans in support of an overall business unit strategy
* Strong client focus with the ability to build good relationships with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
* Strong Employee Relations experience of complex disciplinary, grievance and performance management activities, especially with employees in senior management/leadership level
* Motivate team members through effective monitoring, coaching, counselling and providing a positive working environment
* Develop strong relationship with other Talent Centre of Excellence teams to ensure that centrally developed products and initiatives meet the requirements of the business unit
* Ability to work with ambiguity and build consensus across diverse, often global, groups


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Graduate or a post graduate qualification in a Business or Human Resource discipline is desirable.
* 8 \-12 years of proven HR generalist experience (e.g. performance management, employee relations)
* Experience in managing and mentoring teams


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* A professional accreditation or HR specialization certification
* Experience working in a consulting organization or in a similar professional services environment
* Experience of working in a cross\-border, virtual environment would be beneficial


**What We Look For**
* Be an enabler of high\-performance Talent team.
* Keen interest to invest time for self\-learning, seeking opportunities to work on cross\-functional HR projects
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* A self\-starter, independent\-thinker, curious and creative person with desire and passion


**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

**About The Role**
 The People Operations Coordinator \- Global is responsible for delivering a seamless and high\-quality employee experience across the full employee lifecycle. This role serves as a key operational partner, ensuring timely support for employee inquiries, accurate data management across systems, and smooth coordination of onboarding and offboarding processes. With a strong focus on detail, organization, and service, the Coordinator helps maintain compliance, operational efficiency, and a welcoming experience for employees.

* Create new job requisitions (and positions when applicable) in HCM coordinating with cross\-functional partners (People Business Partners, Finance, Talent Acquisition, hiring managers) as needed.
* Responsible for People Operations offboarding tasks including but not limited to: processing terminations in HCM and third\-party systems, coordinating offboard with IT and other departments as needed in accordance with service level agreements, and communication with departing and former employees.
* Ensure protection and security of all confidential information through proper controls and discretion.
* Assist with compliance reporting and audits such as benefit reporting, government filings, and ad hoc reporting requests.
* Maintain employee files ensuring accuracy, organization, and compliance.
* Support for People team initiatives as needed such as: Annual Compensation Review, performance cycles, handbook and policy launches, annual trainings, etc.

* 1\-3\+ years of HR administrative support experience

* International experience/exposure a plus but not required; preferably HR experience supporting North America and EMEA
* Familiarity with Excel/Google Sheets (experience with filters, vLookup, formulas, etc. is a plus)
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with ability to work independently and in a fast\-paced environment
* A strong problem\-solver with a proactive approach to challenges, able to work independently.


 AlphaSense is an equal\-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non\-merit factor.  In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
   

  

 Recruiting Scams and Fraud

title: Senior Network Engineer, Google Enterprise Networking
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in network design or network test automation.
* 6 years of experience with network routing protocols, design and troubleshooting, with network equipment providers.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience with identifying network problems, writing documents to describe test plans and procedures, executing and publishing results of test plans or process documentation, and developing and automating networking products.
* Knowledge of traffic engineering best practices and protocols including Resource Reservation Protocol (RSVP), Fast Reroute (FRR) and MultiProtocol Label Switching (MPLS) and protocols (e.g., LACP, STP, RSTP, VRRP, UDLD, 802\.1x).
* Knowledge of the phases of software test cycle and the types of errors that can be addressed by testing components and products, including the knowledge of differences and considerations for each test phase.


**About the job** 
 Google is proud to boast a network that provides service to millions of Internet users around the world. The Network Engineering team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. As a member of the team, you have a direct impact on design and feature enhancements to keep our systems running smoothly. You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Google's complex network generates a constant stream of challenges which require you to continually be innovative with an evolving set of technologies. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services. Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Define and describe network problems, write documents to describe test plans and procedures, and execute and publish results of test plans or process documentation for Google\-wide use.
* Develop project roadmap, establish project goals, coordinate resources, and provide technical leadership.
* Conduct quantifiable analysis of measurements or data and capacity forecast models for making Google networks more efficient, and deliver predictable user experience. Review test plans, participate in cross\-functional reviews which cover test plans and test results.
* Update the operational requirements to adopt new technology into operations with engineers, architecture, and developers. Identify, troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve software, hardware, and other network and system problems.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Network Engineer
description:
* Position Summary


 The Level 1 (L1\) Network Engineer is responsible for providing first\-level technical support for network infrastructure. This role involves continuous monitoring of network systems, handling initial troubleshooting of network\-related incidents, logging and managing support tickets, and escalating unresolved issues to higher\-level support teams (L2/L3\) in accordance with defined procedures and service\-level agreements (SLAs).
   

  

* Key Responsibilities


**2\.1 Network Monitoring and Operations**
* Monitor network performance, availability, and alerts using network monitoring tools.
* Identify and respond to basic network issues such as link failures, latency, packet loss, and device reachability problems.
* Perform routine health checks of network devices and links.


**2\.2 Incident and Ticket Management**
* Log incidents and service requests in the ticketing system with accurate details.
* Perform first\-level diagnosis and resolution of reported network issues.
* Escalate incidents to L2/L3 teams as per escalation matrix and SLA requirements.
* Track incidents through resolution and provide regular status updates.


**2\.3 Troubleshooting and Support**
* Conduct basic troubleshooting for LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, and VPN connectivity issues.
* Verify physical connections including cables, ports, power status, and link indicators.
* Assist users with basic network\-related issues such as IP conflicts, DNS resolution problems, and connectivity loss.


**2\.4 Network Configuration Support**
* Verify IP addressing, VLAN assignments, DHCP, and DNS settings.
* Execute predefined configuration changes under supervision or SOPs.


**2\.5 Documentation and Reporting**
* Maintain incident reports, network diagrams, and SOP updates.
* Prepare daily shift and handover reports.
* Required Technical Skills
* OSI \& TCP/IP models
* LAN/WAN fundamentals
* IP addressing and subnetting
* VLAN, routing, and switching basics
* DNS, DHCP, ARP, ICMP
* Educational Qualifications
* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
* Certifications (Preferred)
* CCNA
* CompTIA Network\+ or Any equivalent entry\-level networking certification
* Soft Skills
* Good communication skills
* Willingness to work in 24/7 shifts
* Team collaboration

description:
**About Bp**
 Technology is making a difference in bp’s plans to invest in today’s energy systems and help build tomorrow’s. We have a deep history of technical problem\-solving and use advanced technologies across the business, from our remotely managed platform in the Caspian to advanced seismic imaging and biogas production. Technology provides a competitive edge in our oil and gas business and creates products that underpin our differentiated brands such as Castrol, bp Ultimate and Aral. Our digital teams enable the underlying infrastructure from which our staff and sites operate and connect every day; protecting and safeguarding our systems, assets and people from digital threats; and leverage digital technology to deliver the products, platforms and services our business needs. Technology is driving value and returns for bp as an integrated energy company.
   

  

**Let Me Tell You About The Role**
 We are seeking a highly capable
 **Technical Writer** 
 to play a
 **critical role in scaling our internal developer platform across the engineering** 
 while supporting the full engineering journey – from onboarding in bp to shipping products.
   

  

 This role sits at the heart of engineering enablement. You will ensure that engineers can effectively adopt platform capabilities, standardized workflows, and AI\-enabled tools by providing clear, structured, and trustworthy documentation. Your work will directly impact engineering productivity, platform adoption, and the successful rollout of AI\-driven initiatives across the company.
   

  

 By acting as the central connective point between engineering, product, data, and business stakeholders in bp, the role improves delivery predictability, accelerates time\-to\-value for critical initiatives, reduces execution risk, and enables teams to with valuable AI and Engineering standards documentation that unlock speed, scalability and lasting engineering excellence for the team. Ultimately, this role strengthens engineering effectiveness, operational discipline, and the organization’s ability to turn technical engineering investment into measurable business value for bp.
   

  

**What You Will Deliver**
* Own and develop documentation that enables the internal developer platform to scale across engineering teams.
* Create onboarding guides, platform usage documentation, architectural overviews, and self\-service enablement content for engineers.
* Document standard patterns, workflows, APIs, tooling, and best practices that support consistent platform adoption.
* Partner with platform engineering, DevOps, and security teams to ensure documentation reflects current capabilities and guardrails.


**AI Enablement**
* Create and maintain documentation that supports the adoption of AI tools, workflows, and capabilities within engineering and adjacent teams.
* Translate AI\-related technical concepts, processes, and governance into clear, actionable documentation for engineers and stakeholders.
* Support responsible AI usage by documenting guidelines, constraints, and approved patterns aligned with company policy.


**Engineering Onboarding \& Process Documentation**
* Develop structured onboarding documentation for engineers covering tools, systems, processes, and ways of working.
* Document engineering standards, design handovers, and internal workflows aligned with energy\-industry requirements.
* Create and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and process documentation used throughout the engineering lifecycle.


**Engineering to Shipping Journey**
* Document the end\-to\-end lifecycle from engineering release through manufacturing readiness, inspection, packing, and shipping.
* Collaborate with engineering, quality, supply chain, and logistics teams to ensure accurate and consistent handover documentation.
* Ensure documentation supports operational continuity and audit readiness.


**Content Governance \& Continuous Improvement**
* Establish and maintain documentation standards, templates, style guides, and version control.
* Ensure documentation meets internal quality standards, regulatory expectations, and audit requirements common in the energy sector.
* Continuously improve content based on user feedback, platform evolution, and process changes.


**What you will need to be successful (experience and qualifications)**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Technical Communication, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience as a Technical Writer in engineering\-led, platform, or industrial environments.
* Strong ability to understand and document developer platforms, engineering workflows, and technical systems.
* Proven experience creating onboarding content, platform documentation, SOPs, and lifecycle documentation.
* Excellent written English with a strong focus on clarity, structure, and usability.
* Experience working closely with engineers, platform teams, and subject\-matter experts.
* Proficiency with documentation tools such as Confluence, SharePoint, Markdown\-based systems, or similar.
* Experience documenting internal developer platforms, DevOps tooling, or cloud\-native environments.
* Exposure to AI/ML platforms, AI governance, or enterprise AI adoption.
* Background in energy, oil \& gas, power, renewables, or heavy engineering industries.

 Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner! At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and challenging environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. ****Role Overview****
****About the role:****
 The Technical Writer will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining high\-quality technical documentation that empowers our Technical Support team and our customers to quickly and effectively resolve product issues. This role is crucial in translating complex technical information and support best practices into clear, concise, and user\-friendly knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal support procedures.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Write and edit customer\-facing and internal technical support content, including FAQ articles, troubleshooting guides, how\-to tutorials, and known issue workarounds.
* Develop and maintain internal procedural documentation for the Technical Support team, such as escalation paths, diagnostic steps, and new feature support processes (SOPs).
* Ensure all documentation adheres to established style guides, voice, and quality standards for clarity, accuracy, and consistency.
* Organize and structure technical content within the Knowledge Base/Content Management System (CMS) to ensure high findability and usability for both internal agents and external customers.
* Work closely with Technical Support Engineers, Product Engineers, Quality Assurance, and Product Managers to gather necessary information and validate technical accuracy.
* Proactively identify areas where documentation is needed based on support ticket trends, customer feedback, and internal team requests.
* Gather feedback from the Technical Support team and customers to continuously improve content, addressing clarity, completeness, and effectiveness.
* Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for documentation (e.g., article views, time\-to\-resolution, case deflection rate) and use data to prioritize and optimize content.
* Manage the full documentation lifecycle, including regular reviews and necessary updates to reflect product changes, new issues, and updated support processes.


**Skills**
* Knowledge of Operating systems, networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, SSL) and cloud technologies like AWS, Azure
* Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, easy\-to\-understand content for various audiences (technical and non\-technical).
* Ability to quickly learn and understand complex software, hardware, or technical systems. Familiarity with technical support environments is a significant plus.
* Meticulous editing and proofreading skills to ensure content is accurate and error\-free.
* Experience with documentation tools, Content Management Systems (CMS), and Knowledge Base platforms (e.g., Zendesk Guide, Confluence, SharePoint, etc.).
* Ability to manage multiple documentation projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering..
* 3 \+ years of professional experience as a Technical Writer or Knowledge content creator preferably in a role supporting a Customer Support, Technical Support, or Customer Success team.
* Portfolio of work demonstrating clear and effective technical documentation samples.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with ticketing systems (e.g., JIRA Service Desk/Management(JSD/JSM), ServiceNow, Salesforce Service Cloud).
* Familiarity with Network/ Cloud Security concepts.
* Experience with visual communication tools for creating diagrams and screenshots.

title: CBS-BMC- Technology Enablement-Senior Associate - Technical Writer and Trainer Marcom products
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Discipline BMC\- Technology Enablement**
**Role Type Technical writer and trainer \- Marcom products**
**The opportunity**
 The Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC) Technical Writer and Trainer – MarCom Products leads the creation, maintenance, and delivery of high\-quality technical documentation and training for all MarCom\-supported products and platforms. This role ensures that diverse audiences have access to clear, accurate, and up\-to\-date resources, enabling successful adoption and ongoing use of MarCom platforms. By collaborating with cross\-functional teams, this position drives content excellence, knowledge enablement, and strategic communication, supporting business transformation, product launches, and brand initiatives.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 In this role, you will drive training and documentation excellence across the organization and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support business transformation by:
   

  

* Lead Strategic Content Development: Develop, review, and continuously improve user guides, knowledge base articles, process documentation, and training materials for all MarCom\-supported products, platforms, and campaigns. Ensure content aligns with brand voice, messaging, and strategic objectives.
* Design \& Deliver Engaging Training: Create and facilitate training programs (virtual, in\-person, and self\-paced) for onboarding, upskilling, and product launches. Tailor learning experiences to marketing, communications, and business audiences, focusing on driving adoption and engagement.
* Collaborate for Impact: Partner with product managers, subject matter experts, and MarCom teams to ensure documentation and training reflect the latest features, updates, and best practices. Support campaign launches and strategic initiatives with clear, audience\-centric content.
* Establish Content Standards \& Governance: Develop and maintain documentation standards, templates, and governance processes to ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance with organizational and brand policies.
* Analyze \& Optimize Learning: Use feedback and usage data to identify gaps in knowledge and proactively address business needs. Continuously refining content and training approaches to maximize impact and user experience.
* Oversee Content Lifecycle: Manage version control, archiving, and timely retirement of obsolete materials, ensuring all documentation remains relevant and strategically aligned.
* Facilitate Knowledge Sharing: Coordinate regular workshops, knowledge\-sharing sessions, and Q\&A forums to foster a culture of continuous learning and collaboration within MarCom and across business units.
* Support Change Management: Develop communication plans and resources that drive user adoption of new MarCom initiatives, minimize resistance, and reinforce strategic priorities.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Expertise in technical writing, instructional design, and adult learning principles—applied in a marketing communications context.
* Strategic mindset with the ability to translate complex information into clear, persuasive, and brand\-aligned content.
* Strong project management skills; able to deliver high\-quality outputs within tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills—able to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels, both technical and non\-technical.
* Proficiency with documentation tools (e.g., Confluence, SharePoint, MS Word), e\-learning platforms, and multimedia content creation.
* Ability to synthesize technical and marketing information into user\-friendly, audience\-centric content.
* Collaborative team player, comfortable working in virtual, cross\-functional, and global environments.
* Analytical approach focused on continuous improvement, user experience, and strategic business outcomes.
* Adaptability to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced, and agile MarCom environment.


**To qualify for the role, you must have:**
* 3\+ years of experience in technical documentation, training, or enablement roles.
* Demonstrated success in designing and delivering training programs for technology products or platforms.
* Strong knowledge of documentation standards, version control, and content management systems.
* Experience collaborating with product, engineering, and support teams in a global organization.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver results under pressure.
* Excellent written and verbal English language communication with stakeholders across geographies.


**Ideally, you’ll also have:**
* Experience with video production, e\-learning authoring tools, and interactive training content.
* Experience working with highly diverse and geographically dispersed teams
* An outgoing personality and a great sense of humor


**What we look for:**
 We’re seeking a proactive, detail\-oriented professional with a passion for empowering users and teams through effective documentation and engaging training. The ideal candidate will be a self\-starter who thrives on collaboration, embraces challenges, and is committed to driving continuous improvement in knowledge management and user enablement.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success, as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Software Engineer I, ITC
description:
**Who You’ll Work With**
 We are the Enterprise Insights \& Experience Engineering team at Nike and we provide cutting\-edge service management solutions that enable Nike businesses to run their operations efficiently. We use ServiceNow as our Enterprise Service Management platform. ServiceNow enables our departments to digitize and automate business processes. We use it for its intuitive, omni\-channel user experience with service portals, mobile interface and apps, and chat. We use its AI/ML capabilities with Virtual Agent for automated and prompt user interaction. We make use of its rich analytics features with trends and breakdowns. We also recognize that an effective and efficient digital ecosystem is made up of best\-in\-breed applications and we make use of ServiceNow APIs that enable workflows across platforms. We also incorporate GenAI solutions with ServiceNow to enhance efficiency for business. ServiceNow is used at Nike for varied use cases \- our Retail Store Athletes use the ServiceNow mobile app to request support on PoS systems promptly; our HR team uses ServiceNow as a medium for employees to seek HR cases support; our Technology Operations teams uses ServiceNow to manage incidents, fulfil requests using a service catalog, manage changes and host user facing knowledge articles as well as technical knowledge articles. We also use Performance Analytics to track Key Performance Indicators; our Procurement team uses it to manage purchase requests; our Risk \& Compliance team uses it to manage risks; our Retail Partners team has setup a portal using ServiceNow for retail partners to seek technical support \- the list goes on.
   

  

**Who We Are Looking For**
 We’re looking for graduates with around 2 years of experience with the ServiceNow platform. Ideal candidate will have strong programming skills with exposure to automation frameworks, API\-driven development and familiarity with GenAI and Agentic frameworks and good interpersonal skills to collaborate with peers, product managers and business stakeholders. This role does configuration, development, administration and operational support tasks for all aspects of the ServiceNow platform including standard configuration, security, data management, reporting, integrations with third party applications and environment management while ensuring that data integrity, platform health and best practices are maintained.
   

  

**What You’ll Work On**
 If this is you, you’ll be working with product managers to deliver technical solutions via Agile methodology that solve business problems while supporting the long\-term health of the ServiceNow platform.
   

  

 You will develop solutions using ServiceNow functionalities: \-
   

  

* Design intuitive forms using Form Designer, UI policies
* Build server\-side and client\-side scripting
* Set up Access Control Lists
* Use Flow Designer to build workflows
* Set up notifications
* Design Service Portals
* Configure Chat
* Setup analytics and reporting
* Integrate with other platforms using APIs
* Author technical knowledge articles
* Participate in Scrum cadences – backlog refinement, sprint planning, retrospectives, stand\-ups


 You will maintain the platform integrity, security and performance: \-
   

  

* Apply patches and system upgrades on scheduled basis
* Troubleshoot and remediate functionality related incidents


 You will work with a global team of engineers to unlock the potential of data using GenAI solutions.

 Our diverse 4,000\+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.

 JavaScript Software Developer at BairesDev
 



  





 As a JavaScript Software Developer at BairesDev, you will design and implement interactive web applications using JavaScript and related technologies. You'll leverage your experience to develop responsive user interfaces, optimize front\-end performance, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality software that provides exceptional user experiences.

 \- Troubleshoot, debug, and upgrade existing web applications to improve performance and user experience.
 



 \- Participate in code reviews and technical discussions to improve overall code quality.
 



  





 What We Are Looking For:
 



  





 \- 3\+ years of experience with JavaScript development.
 



 \- Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks and libraries.
 



 \- Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and responsive web design principles.
 



 \- Familiarity with RESTful APIs and asynchronous request handling.
 



 \- Understanding of browser compatibility issues and solutions.
 



 \- Experience with version control systems, preferably Git.
 



 \- Advanced level of English.

 Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!
